fields.statement: At 24bb152 (leaf commits 55a7b97 + 24bb152): read the diff. CommitCheckWrites in internal/api/run_checks.go now adds the session actor's uncommitted record entries even when the actor wrote no model entries, and still returns no commit when nothing is uncommitted. TestCommitCheckWritesNone was changed to assert: a critic session whose actor wrote no model entries makes one commit 'chore(rhiza): record quality critic writes' on HEAD with trailers exactly 'Change: <cs>' and 'Actor: <actor>' (no Leaf:), touching only .rhiza/log/, leaving only the other actor's entry untracked in .rhiza; a second call makes no commit and leaves HEAD. go test ./internal/api -run TestCommitCheckWrites -v -count=1: both PASS. Attempt-1 finding (review-summary golden) fixed: go test ./cmd/rhiza ./internal/api -count=1 ok; fmt-check, vet, self-check ok. make check's only failure was TestGeneratedModel's 50ms read-time budget (52.5ms median) in internal/tui/modelapp, untouched by this leaf; it passed when rerun alone.
